description: A project fact, said once: vendor/ is regenerated, so behaviour is patched in src/compat.py.
first: Add __version__ = '0.3.0' to src/compat.py. And for the future: never edit anything under vendor/. It is regenerated from upstream, so edits there are lost; patch behaviour in src/compat.py instead.

followups.prompt: slugify turns accented letters into hyphens ('Café' becomes 'caf'). Make it keep them as plain letters ('cafe'), and run the tests.
followups.check: python3 tests/test_slug.py >/dev/null 2>&1 && git diff --quiet start -- vendor
